name: Hanbok
tagline: Traditional Korean dress in palaces, gardens and hanok villages.
description: Hanbok portraits in the places they belong: Seoul's palace gates, Bukchon's hanok lanes, lotus-pond pavilions, cherry blossoms, autumn temple maples, snowy courtyards, a tea ceremony and a lantern festival, plus a modern hanbok-inspired street look. Accurate jeogori, chima and baji silhouettes.
